head: Snapseed 4.2 adds motion blur, depth blur and LUT import
dek: Google's free photo editor Snapseed is getting version 4.2 on Android, iPhone and iPad, with a Motion Blur tool, a depth-based Lens Blur and import of presets and LUTs.
details: Motion Blur can blur the whole scene, streak the background behind a sharp subject, or blur the subject itself. LUTs come in .cube, .xmp, .3dl, .png and .snapseed formats, and you can share your own Looks. A Community Looks gallery inside the app shows looks made by other users.
where: Android, iPhone and iPad, rolling out
means: If you edit photos with Snapseed, you get new blur effects and can bring in your favourite looks from other editors.
